_comment: fixture-watch configuration. Edit this file in the GitHub web UI; the watcher reads it on every run. Everything the watcher follows is here — nothing is hardcoded in the scripts.
_completeFixtureSlotsEvery: Reduced cadence, and it applies ONLY to a team that has a game in EVERY non-finals round of its grade AND still has a game to come — nothing is left to publish for it until finals. Everything else is checked on EVERY slot, including a team missing rounds (a fixture block is being published) and a team whose last scheduled game has passed (the finals hunt). Nothing is ever stopped by this — see stopAfterSeasonEndDays.
_gradeRoundsRefreshHours: How long a grade's round list is cached in state before it is re-fetched. It is also re-fetched whenever the fixture is incomplete, the grade changes, or the last scheduled game has passed — the case where finals rounds get added.
_activeChangeWindowDays: A team that changed within this many days stays on the FULL cadence even with a complete fixture, so the aftermath of a regrade is watched closely.
_stopAfterSeasonEndDays: A team is dropped this many days after its season's endDate. A season with NO endDate is never dropped on age — 808 seasons in the database have none, and a missing date is not an ended season.
_failureAlertCooldownHours: At most one 'watcher failed' alert in this many hours, so a PlayHQ outage does not spam the phone. The run still goes red every time.
_maxAlertChars: Pushover hard limit is 1024. Messages are built up to this and then truncated with a count of what was left out.
